…criptor (line pipeline step 2)

The group stage no longer renders its TextBuf to one contiguous String:
the streaming peephole walks the group's chunk array in place (every
group chunk is one newline-terminated function text, an invariant
restored by chunks-normalize for any partial-line caller), records
reference their own chunk as src, and the single group render becomes
one exact-size allocation with surviving records blitted in coalesced
runs. The transient CompilerBackendPeepholeLine shrinks 168 -> 96 bytes
(12 fields: span/mnemonic/flags packed words, 1-biased packed register
bytes, op-dst-end and zext-dst derived), cutting the per-pair-transfer
copy from 225 to 56 instructions. No rule's decision logic changes.

Output byte-identical for full self-compiles on both targets at both
opt levels; bootstrap fixpoint holds. opt1 self-compile
-274,058,935 Ir (-0.490%); alloc_delta -67.9 MB; peak unchanged.

Refs #5850.

commits.messageBody:
…tions

compiler-backend-jump-target-is-fallthrough? can only suppress a block
terminator's jmp when the target is the immediately next block. When the
target is instead reached through a chain of blocks that each emit zero
bytes -- the pervasive source shape (if c (begin ...) unit) leaves an
else block whose own jump is already fallthrough-suppressed and whose
phi-edge copies coalesce away -- the jmp survives and jumps to the very
next instruction, retired once per taken iteration.

A final rewrite over each assembled function body deletes every direct
jmp whose target label is reached scanning forward across nothing but
label-definition lines. Anything else between them (instruction,
directive, comment, blank line) keeps the jmp, as does a target never
seen forward: loop back edges and trap self-jumps survive. The scan is
one linear pass feeding the output buffer the complement of the deleted
line ranges, so a body with no deletion allocates nothing; the seam
(compiler-backend-emit-function's final body assembly) is shared by the
linux and windows text targets and runs after the prologue splice, rsp
rebase, and FPO audit, so the scan sees exactly the bytes the assembler
will.

  benchmark/typelisp/opt_quicksort   463,215,364 -> 443,435,279  (-4.27%)
  benchmark/typelisp/hashmap_grow      1,883,308 ->   1,858,709  (-1.31%)
  benchmark/typelisp/hashmap_churn     4,286,936 ->   4,251,139  (-0.84%)
  benchmark/typelisp/opt_crc32       324,986,121 -> 324,926,118
  benchmark/typelisp/spmd_reduce   1,478,413,867 -> 1,478,113,865

No row regressed; self_compile +0.21% (41% of tolerance). An asm-shape
gate pins the rule on both targets: the then-only-if fixture must emit
no jmp whose target follows across label lines only, while its backward
self-jump and a both-arms-live control must keep theirs.
